# Spike fixture — a helper doubles a number

Throwaway one-AC FR for the STE-714 measurement spike. Never committed to any shared branch.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC-SPIKE.1: `plugins/dev-process-toolkit/adapters/_shared/src/spike_double.ts` exports `double(n: number): number`, returning `n * 2`, tested by `plugins/dev-process-toolkit/tests/spike-double.test.ts`.

## Technical Design

One pure function in one new file.

## Testing

One test file with two cases (a positive number and zero). Run only that file: `cd plugins/dev-process-toolkit && bun test tests/spike-double.test.ts`.
